sourceLabel: Bundled deterministic demo dataset (illustrative, not measured)

zones.name: Connaught Place
zones.description: Circular commercial hub with heavy outer-circle traffic and diesel generator use.

zones.name: India Gate & Kartavya Path
zones.description: Open lawns and wide avenues; ventilated but ringed by arterial traffic.

zones.name: New Delhi Railway Station
zones.description: Rail yard, taxi and bus stands with persistent idling and freight movement.

zones.name: Chandni Chowk
zones.description: Dense wholesale bazaar: generators, street cooking and congested lanes.

zones.name: Red Fort Precinct
zones.description: Heritage precinct between Netaji Subhash Marg and the Ring Road.

zones.name: Kashmere Gate
zones.description: Interstate bus terminal and interchange with heavy diesel and CNG bus flows.

zones.name: Yamuna Riverfront
zones.description: Open floodplain corridor; better ventilation but exposed to riverbed dust.

zones.name: Laxmi Nagar
zones.description: High-density mixed use along Vikas Marg with metro extension works.

zones.name: Anand Vihar
zones.description: Bus terminal, rail terminus and industrial border edge — a chronic hotspot.

zones.name: Mayur Vihar
zones.description: Residential group housing downwind of the Ghazipur landfill.

zones.name: Lodhi Garden
zones.description: Large tree-covered park; the cleanest pocket in the central city.

zones.name: Hauz Khas & Green Park
zones.description: Residential colonies and markets with active redevelopment sites.

zones.name: Qutub Minar & Mehrauli
zones.description: Heritage zone with ridge greenery; road widening adds coarse dust.

zones.name: Nehru Place
zones.description: Office towers and IT market beside the Outer Ring Road.

zones.name: Mayapuri Industrial Area
zones.description: Metal recycling, furnaces and freight depots with open burning.

zones.name: Outer Ring Works
zones.description: Flyover and depot construction with haul-road dust.

zones.name: NH-48 Corridor
zones.description: Expressway freight corridor and toll plaza queues.
